# Michael's Treasures

> Vintage watch dealer in Prague, Czechia, run personally by Michal Sopoliga.
> Exceptional vintage watches — personally selected, inspected and
> photographed. Viewings in Prague by appointment. Fully insured worldwide
> shipping.

## About

- Business: Michael's Treasures (sole trader: Michal Sopoliga)
- Location: Prague, Czechia (viewings by appointment, usually within a day
  or two of asking)
- Website: https://praguevintagewatches.com
- Email: michael@praguevintagewatches.com
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/michaels.treasures (@michaels.treasures)
- Serves: EU and worldwide (insured, tracked shipping)

## What Michael's Treasures offers

- Curated vintage mechanical watches, photographed honestly — on the wrist,
  in daylight, flaws included.
- Original dials unless stated otherwise; redials, service dials and
  replaced hands are always disclosed in writing.
- The available stock changes constantly; every new arrival is posted on
  Instagram, usually weekly. There is no static catalogue.
- Also buys vintage watches — collectors thinking of selling can enquire by
  email or Instagram.

## How buying works

1. Enquire — message on Instagram or via the website contact form.
2. See it — additional photographs, video and movement shots on request;
   in-person viewings in Prague by appointment.
3. Receive it — insured shipping across the EU and worldwide, or in-person
   handover in Prague. Payment by bank transfer, or cash in person; an
   invoice with the registered company details is issued for every watch.

## FAQ

- Can I see the watch in person? Yes — viewings in Prague by appointment,
  usually within a day or two.
- Do you ship outside the EU? Yes — fully insured, worldwide, with tracking.
- Are the dials original? Unless stated otherwise, yes; any redial or
  replaced part is disclosed in writing before anything is agreed.
- How do I pay? Bank transfer for most sales, or cash in person in Prague.
